decisions.identity: 2003 Ultra: first 250 cards issued in original November 2002 product. Cross-brand later 15 U-251..U-265 serialized /1500 isolated from original wax.
decisions.base: 200 regular #1-200, 20 All-Stars #201-220, 20 2002-rookie-design #221-240, 10 prospects #241-250. BCP and independent MCB reconcile all 250 player/team/number.
decisions.rookies: Only true original base RC is #249 Dave Pember per TCDB. Fifteen later Ultra-design cards are individually TCDB recognized rookie updates, but packed exclusively in Fleer Rookies & Greats.
decisions.names: BCP/MCB source differences #70 Tony Armas/Jr, #81 Bob/Bobby Abreu, #191 Jose Cruz/Jr, #235 Will/Wil Nieves, and insert Ichiro/Suzuki variations reviewed. External U-255 Michael/Mike Hessman reviewed.
decisions.gold: All 250 authentic original base number Gold Medallion hobby-only. Gold standard 1 per pack, All-Stars and rookies 1:24, not fictitiously numbered 1G-250G.
decisions.hits: Photo Effex Gold 20 /25; Back 2 Back insert 17 /1000; Back 2 Back Memorabilia 17 /500 and Gold 17 /50; Double Up Memorabilia 16 /100; vintage When It Was A Game Used 12 individually serial capped.
decisions.memo: Moonshots Game Used 20 plus all 17 Back 2 Back game-used, 16 double-player game-used, 12 vintage/modern game-used. All published material types and printed original number codes preserved.
decisions.sourceExceptions: BaseballCardPedia mistakenly labels When It Was A Game #38-40 WH; independent MyCardBatch plus documented physical cards identify the printed suffix as WG. Physical WG used.
decisions.odds: Hobby/retail 10 cards/pack x24 box; guaranteed Gold hobby only; subsets different frequency; two game-used per Hobby box; serial- and cross-product issues require per-slot and per-channel logic not available as integer ProductSet odds. Leave all oddsPerPack null to prevent fake odds.
decisions.images: Never invent real card, relic swatch, 2002 rookie design, autograph, pack/box artwork. Source scans/pricing/collation need independent QA; draft stays unreleased.
decisions.safety: Only insert 2003_Ultra_Baseball and its 15 ProductSets, preserving existing prices/images and ownership for every other product. Released false.

productSets.name: Base Set
productSets.notes: 250 original Ultra wax #1-250 (200 veterans, 20 All-Stars, 20 2002 Ultra design rookies, 10 2003 prospects). Dave Pember #249 true RC only, verified TCDB.

productSets.name: Gold Medallion
productSets.notes: 250 original Gold Medallion, retaining base physical number. Hobby only: 1-200 one per pack, 201-220 SP 1:24, 221-250 SP 1:24. Not serial-numbered.

productSets.name: Ultra Rookie Update (Fleer Rookies & Greats ONLY)
productSets.notes: 15 original U-251 to U-265 Ultra-design rookie update cards, serial /1500, exclusively packed in 2003 Fleer Rookies & Greats (Dec 2003), NOT 2003 Ultra wax.

productSets.name: Photo Effex Gold /25
productSets.notes: All 20 original Photo Effex Gold serial /25, original PE numbers retained.

productSets.name: When It Was A Game
productSets.notes: Original 40 vintage/modern WG and WH insert cards, odds hobby 1:20 retail 1:12; historical teams accurately preserved.

productSets.name: Back 2 Back /1000
productSets.notes: Original 17 numbered B2B insert cards; each serial numbered /1000.

productSets.name: Moonshots Memorabilia
productSets.notes: 20 original game-used cards with source-printed letter IDs and exact material BAT/JSY/BASE/PANTS.

productSets.name: Back 2 Back Memorabilia /500
productSets.notes: 17 original B2B memorabilia, exact original letter IDs and individual materials; all serial /500.

productSets.name: Back 2 Back Memorabilia Gold /50
productSets.notes: 17 authentic Gold game-used versions each numbered /50, retaining source letter code.

productSets.name: Double Up Memorabilia /100
productSets.notes: 16 source-verified dual-player memorabilia with individual swatch materials; original printed DU numbers and serial /100.

productSets.name: When It Was A Game Used
productSets.notes: 12 original game-used historical/modern cards, numbered /100, /150, /200 or /300 as appropriate, individually verified.

productSets.name: 2003 Ultra Printed Checklist (NNO)
productSets.notes: One actual unnumbered printed checklist, '2003 ULTRA MLB Checklist' front and Checklist: 1-186 detail, kept separate from numbered base.
